target.law: stationary continuum Matern on ambient reference coordinates, restricted to observed tissue
target.limitation: Composition with a warped paint field is not itself asserted stationary.

coordinates.raw_preservation: unchanged raw float64 coordinates; inverse is algebraic, not promised bitwise floating-point roundtrip

support: all eligible cells; glial observation rows unchanged; tissue holes are labels, not automatic internal boundary conditions
domain: convex hull of all eligible section coordinates, fine collar, then outward buffer; scientific tissue labels remain separate; proposal only

representatives.rationale: Supplement coverage with geometry extremes before any candidate covariance evaluation; proposed not frozen

grading_distance: d outward from fine collar; h_inner retained inside collar

probes.boundary: distance to convex hull plus detected persistent-empty-region boundary; require separated reporting
probes.selection: deterministic farthest-point selection; source-row tie breaks; no repeated identity; mandatory extreme sparse observations included in sparse allocation
probes.strata_rule: boundary lowest-distance quartile, interior highest-distance quartile, dense lowest-density-radius quartile, sparse highest-density-radius quartile; fill sequentially without duplication
probes.all_observation_checks: coverage, row identity, partition of unity and affine coordinate reproduction for every modeled cell

checks: active covariance root with positive diagonal QR convention
directional likelihood-algebra tests on synthetic vectors, not MCMC
derivatives.near_zero: report absolute error normalized by covariance/root scale; never divide by a vanishing derivative

range_guarantee: No proven uniform continuum guarantee. Proposed empirical acceptance over central99 range grid and fixed probes. Between-grid bounds or separate certification required before a formal interval-wide guarantee.
tails: Original prior remains unbounded; no silent truncation or rejected draws. Report 1% prior tail and diagnostics at .15 and 5. A future run leaving certified coverage requires a preapproved policy; stop and revise the numerical specification in a new run rather than change its mesh within a chain.

resources.runtime: unmeasured; benchmark one representative before extrapolation; no invented walltime forecast

selection: Pareto comparison of accuracy, total/active vertices, memory, build/eigensolve/QR/derivative time; no candidate chosen by active vertex count alone; resource failures are not accuracy passes
